task.title: Add resumable semantic history validation
task.description: Add workbook validate [--full] [--json] as the explicit exhaustive semantic history verification path. Default sync never waits for this audit; new or changed task heads become validation-pending in disposable SQLite. Validate operation histories and state checkpoints in the foreground with no daemon or detached process, cache validated immutable commit IDs with a validator format version, resume safely after interruption, and normally inspect only unseen descendants after the last validated ancestor. --full bypasses cached validation. Report tasks and commits checked, cache hits, valid, invalid, and pending counts, and the exact failing task, commit, and error category. Never mutate canonical task refs. Expose validation status through SQLite for future history and change-review queries, while preserving complete rebuildability from Git. Acceptance targets at a minimum 500-task by 20-operation workload: first exhaustive audit <=10s; cached unchanged audit <=500ms; five tasks with one new operation each <=1s; and <=12 Git processes for every case with process count independent of history depth. Keep sync --validate-history as a possible future convenience, not part of this story.
